specs.Item Highlight: Up to 60H Playback, 50mm Drivers, Signature Sound, Easy Access Controls, BEASTTM Mode, Bluetooth v5.4, Type-C Interface

features: 50mm Drivers: Experience deep, immersive audio powered by extra-large 50mm dynamic drivers. Specially engineered to push higher acoustic volume and enhanced frequency response, they deliver punchy bass notes alongside clear mids and crisp highs directly to your ears.

Total Playback: 60 Hours: Fuel your listening routine for days without constantly hunting for a charger. The high-capacity battery provides up to 60 hours of total continuous playback on a single full charge, easily powering through long workweeks and extended travel.

boAt Signature Sound: Enjoy iconic, expert-tuned audio profiles designed to elevate your everyday media. From bass-heavy workout playlists to acoustic tracks and movie dialogue, the balanced soundstage provides an engaging listening experience.

Adaptive Fit: Wear your headphones comfortably for hours on end thanks to an ultra-ergonomic construction. The flexible headband and cushioned earcups adjust smoothly to match your head shape, distributing weight evenly to eliminate pressure points.

Easy Access Controls: Take effortless command over your audio directly from the earcup interface. Conveniently located physical buttons allow you to adjust master volume, skip tracks, answer incoming calls, and trigger voice commands without reaching for your phone.
